summary: Learn process discovery, bottleneck analysis, conformance checking, and event-log techniques. Build practical outputs with TrainingCred.
lede: Process mining uses event data from business systems to reveal how work actually flows. For business analysts and operations or process-improvement professionals, this course teaches practical ways to prepare reliable event logs, map process variants, measure delays and rework, and compare actual flows with BPMN models or control requirements to diagnose workflow issues and prioritize improvements.
audienceIntro: This process mining training is designed for professionals who use operational data to improve workflows, control execution, and support transformation decisions across enterprise and public-service environments.
modules: Process Mining Foundations and Use Cases
Process Mining Tools and Digital Workflows
prerequisites: Working knowledge of at least one business process, such as procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, finance close, customer case handling, or public-service delivery, is recommended. You should be comfortable reading basic process maps and working with spreadsheets. No programming experience is required for completion. The course treats PM4Py scripting, OCEL 2.0, AI-assisted analysis, and platform configuration at conceptual or guided operational application level rather than production engineering level.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
